## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-mcp`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-mcp -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `items.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `mcp.json`
- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `items.jsonl`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `axis-live.jsonl`
- `results_2026-08-11.json`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

# GSPC — conformance bank (MCPBench)

> **Start here — free verify:** [https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) (or the free MCP tool `verify_card` at `https://councilof.ai/mcp`) · **Full catalog:** [https://councilof.ai/catalog.json](https://councilof.ai/catalog.json) · Methodology: [https://councilof.ai/methodology/](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · Measurement, not certification.

Council of AI measurement bank. Measurement, not certification.

![Illustration of people and humanoid robots in a white arena with floating green geometric shapes](https://councilof.ai/images/coliseum_hero_arena.jpg)

**Bank.** Frozen split. Live `n` is the matching axis on `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`, not a Hub score. **Not a certificate.** Art 50 (EUR-Lex): 2 August 2026 live; marking grace 2 December 2026.


**Live measurement.** This bank stands behind the `conformance` row of the live GSPC board: `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc?axis=conformance` (family, kind, status and n are on that row, never typed here; the whole board is `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`). Measurement, not certification.

## Public discovery and verification

- [Live GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc): quote `totals.public_count` and `totals.separation_public_count` from the current response.
- [Hub cards](https://councilof.ai/api/hub-cards): quote current `counts.cells`, `counts.measured` and `counts.unmeasured`; the [Hub cards dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-hub-cards) is a separate bank.
- [MCP endpoint](https://councilof.ai/mcp): use `POST tools/list` for its current tool inventory.
- [OpenAPI catalog](https://councilof.ai/openapi.json) and [GSPC API slice](https://councilof.ai/api/openapi.json): read their current paths and versions.
- [x402 discovery manifest](https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json), [offer catalog](https://councilof.ai/api/x402), and [free door](https://councilof.ai/api/free-door): inspect current terms and any paid route's HTTP 402 challenge at the endpoints.
- [Free card verification](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify) and the [jail goldbank](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-jail-goldbank) are separate public resources.

This dataset describes a frozen bank and points to live services; it does not run a new measurement. The well-known x402 manifest is the discovery authority; any Hub copy is a mirror. A directory listing or self-settlement does not establish adoption or an external buyer. The merchant `payTo` address is a receiver, not the signer. Measurement, not certification.
